_about: Generated by scripts/gen-native-vocab.mjs from public/dssl. Do not edit by hand. Array order is the engine's insertion order.

defaultTokens.font.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
defaultTokens.font.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

scale.doc: feature size in px: how big the grains, cells or lines are

intensity.doc: how strong the layer is, 0 to 1 (more than 1 over-drives it)

contrast.doc: noise contrast: 1 is as generated, higher is harsher

threshold.doc: noise cut-off: only values above it show (glitter uses a high one)

contour.doc: draw thin lines where the noise crosses the threshold, instead of a plain cut: veins, rings, contours

octaves.doc: noise detail layers, 1 is smooth, 5 is rough

seed.doc: a different random pattern with the same look

stretch.doc: stretch noise features along x and y, e.g. stretch 40 1 for wood grain

depth.doc: bump height: how deep the relief looks

angle.doc: direction of lines and patterns, in degrees

thickness.doc: line or grid-line width in px

radius.doc: dot size as a fraction of the cell (plaid: how wide the bands are as a fraction of the repeat)

softness.doc: how soft the edges of dots and lines are

animate.doc: milliseconds per shimmer step (film-grain flicker); 0 is still

type.doc: noise flavour: fractal is clouds, turbulence is veins

blend.doc: how the layer mixes with what is under it

color.doc: the main colour (dark end of noise, ink of lines and dots)

color2.doc: the second colour (light end of noise, background cell of patterns)

figure.doc: rings generator: how strongly the growth rings arch into a cathedral figure, 0 is straight grain

warp.doc: rings generator: how much each ring wobbles along its length

pores.doc: rings generator: fine fibre and pore streaks between the rings

knots.doc: rings generator: how many knots in one tile (the pattern repeats, so keep it small)

planks.doc: rings generator: lay it out as planks this many px tall, with a seam and a slightly different board each

symmetrical.doc: mirror every other tile, so each edge meets its own reflection: no seam, and the repeat is twice as far apart. x mirrors left to right, y top to bottom, both (the default) does both. Works on the image-based textures (noise, bump, rings, waves, hex).

density.doc: starfield and terrazzo: how many stars or chips in a tile, 1 is normal

grain.doc: fine film grain, neutral on any colour

rough.doc: gritty relief, like a rough cast wall

paper.doc: soft paper fibre with a little unevenness

crumpled.doc: crumpled foil or paper, big creases

wood.doc: long wood grain, along x (use angle 90 for vertical)

oak.doc: oak: open grain, tan with brown rings

walnut.doc: walnut: dark chocolate with black-brown rings

cherry.doc: cherry: warm red-brown with fine rings

maple.doc: maple: pale, tight, nearly plain grain

pine.doc: pine: light yellow wood with wide rings and knots

ebony.doc: ebony: nearly black with faint streaks

birch.doc: birch: creamy pale wood with fine rings

oak-planks.doc: oak laid as planks, with seams

walnut-planks.doc: walnut laid as planks, with seams

brushed.doc: brushed metal, fine lines along x

grid.doc: a square grid, like graph paper

bricks.doc: a red brick wall, light mortar

herringbone.doc: parquet laid in a zigzag, every board a slightly different shade

plaid.doc: simple plaid: wide bands crossing, thin lines between

tartan.doc: a red tartan with green and navy bands

starfield.doc: a night sky of small and large stars

snow.doc: fresh snow with a few sparkles

grass.doc: blades of grass seen from above

color.doc: the light colour (default: the element's text colour)

radius.doc: how far the glow reaches, in px

pulse.doc: milliseconds for one breath in and out; 0 is steady

depth.doc: how deep the pulse goes, 0 to 1

flicker.doc: random flicker, like a flame: 0 is steady, 1 is wild

seed.doc: a different random flicker with the same look

texture.doc: texture(grain scale 2): break the light up with a texture

essential.doc: keep animating even when the visitor prefers reduced motion

unclipped.doc: let the light spill out of a parent that clips (overflow: hidden, auto, scroll). Without it the aura is cut at that edge, like the element itself

around.doc: the shape the light follows: follow (the default: the element's clip-path or rounded corners), box, round, pill, diamond, triangle, hexagon, octagon, pentagon, star, star4, star6, cross, heart, drop, bolt, alpha (an or 's visible pixels), or polygon(50% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 50%)

inner.doc: light inside the edge (a rim) instead of outside it

rays.doc: that many beams of light from the middle, slowly turning (see spin)

spin.doc: rays turn this many degrees a second (default 10); on particles, how fast each one tumbles

ripple.doc: rings that spread out from the shape and fade, one every this many milliseconds

nohalo.doc: only the rays and ripples, without the soft halo

always.doc: keep emitting even when the element cannot be seen (opacity 0, display: none, visibility: hidden, on it or an ancestor): for an invisible anchor that smoke or sparks come out of

z.doc: the z-index of the layer this light is drawn on: `z 5` puts it under a hill with z-index 10. It meets elements in the page's root stacking context

color.doc: colours over a particle's life: color #ff0 -> #f60 -> transparent

count.doc: how many particles are alive at once

size.doc: diameter in px: size 4, or size 10 4 (start and end of a random range)

life.doc: how long one lives, in ms: life 900, or life 600 1200

speed.doc: px per second: speed 60, or speed 30 90

dir.doc: where they head: up, down, left, right, out, in, or degrees (-90 is up)

spread.doc: how wide the fan of directions is, in degrees

gravity.doc: px/s squared; negative pulls up (flames), positive down (snow)

drag.doc: air resistance: how fast particles slow down

from.doc: where they are born: edge or outline (along the element's real outline, see around), bottom, top, left, right, center, corners, thumb (range sliders)

shape.doc: circle, spark, square, ring, star, flame, smoke, line, heart, diamond, triangle, plus, drop, bubble, snowflake, confetti or leaf

grow.doc: size at the end of life as a multiple of the start: 0.2 shrinks, 3 swells

blend.doc: add makes overlapping particles brighter, normal just stacks them

glowing.doc: soft glowing particles that add light

behind.doc: draw only outside the element's box, as if the element hid them

seed.doc: a different random pattern with the same look

essential.doc: keep animating even when the visitor prefers reduced motion

unclipped.doc: let the particles leave a parent that clips (overflow: hidden, auto, scroll). Without it they are cut at that edge

around.doc: the shape `from edge` and `from outline` follow: follow (the default), box, round, pill, diamond, triangle, hexagon, octagon, pentagon, star, star4, star6, cross, heart, drop, bolt, or polygon(...)

palette.doc: each particle takes ONE of the colours (confetti) instead of fading through them

spin.doc: how fast each particle tumbles, in degrees a second (random direction)

wind.doc: a sideways push, px/s squared; negative pushes left

orbit.doc: the particles circle the middle of the element, this many degrees a second

always.doc: keep emitting even when the element cannot be seen (opacity 0, display: none, visibility: hidden, on it or an ancestor): for an invisible anchor that smoke or sparks come out of

z.doc: the z-index of the layer these particles are drawn on: `z 5` puts them under a hill with z-index 10. It meets elements in the page's root stacking context

clauses.shape: shape circle | square | diamond | pill | bar

glassWords.blur: a number: how many px to blur what is behind the element (default 16)
glassWords.saturate: saturate <n>: colour boost for what shows through, 1 is unchanged (default 1.5)
glassWords.bright: bright <n>: brightness of what shows through, 1 is unchanged
glassWords.tint: tint <color> | tint none: the milky layer on top (default: a faint wash of the text colour)

tiltWords.max: a number: the largest tilt in degrees (default 8)
tiltWords.lift: lift <n>: scale while the pointer is over it, e.g. 1.04
tiltWords.perspective: perspective <px>: how strong the 3D depth looks (default 900)
tiltWords.speed: speed <0.05 to 1>: how quickly it follows (default 0.18)
tiltWords.invert: invert: tilt away from the pointer instead of toward it
tiltWords.glare: glare: also keep --dssl-gx and --dssl-gy (0% to 100%) pointing at the pointer, for your own highlight

words.weights: a weight (400), several (400 700), or a variable range (100..900)
words.italic: also load the italic of each weight
words.display: display <swap|block|fallback|optional>: how the text behaves while the font loads (default swap)
words.from: from "/path/to/file.woff2": use your own file instead of Google Fonts
